scope: Independent re-review of the two transport findings from the completed whole-candidate review and their neighboring ACP SDK interactions

findings.before: A cancellation send could wait indefinitely behind a blocked peer before process cleanup.
findings.after: Each cancellation send has a 0.5-second deadline; a blocked send proceeds to owned-process cleanup.

findings.before: The SDK concatenated stream-reader overrun chunks, permitting an oversized protocol frame, including ignored thoughts.
findings.after: The host rejects frames above 1 MiB and aggregate protocol input above 16 MiB before SDK parsing.

processCleanup: Every independent case reaped its owned process, and os.killpg(pid, 0) raised ProcessLookupError afterward.
diagnostics: Error cases emitted redacted SDK diagnostics.

targetedTests.initialFailure: The new fake-peer fixture used an incorrect extension method name and notification timing. The corrected fixture passed.

limitations: Local fake-peer and real SDK tests only. The separate parent evidence covers the full suite, generated installation, and actual Kiro retrieval.
